title: The Manosphere Isn’t Ready for Brothercore
summary: Vulnerable, huggable, affirming, chiseled: Welcome to Hey Brother House, a content incubator for bros who just want to trauma-dump and play Mario Kart.
llm_summary: Hey Brother House is a new online platform that blends the “manosphere” aesthetic—muscular, affirming, and meme‑laden—with a safe‑space vibe for men to vent, share personal struggles, and unwind over games like Mario Kart.
